title: Surreal Clock and Eye
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large ornate grandfather clock covered in vines and multiple floating eyeballs. In the foreground, a purple-skinned woman with glowing yellow eyes sits beside a green cat, while two armored knights in dynamic poses hold glowing orbs and weapons. A large red shield with a central blue eye dominates the center against a dripping, colorful background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of an ornate wooden grandfather clock entwined with vines and dripping with multiple eyeballs, a large red shield with a central all-seeing eye, two glowing armored knights in action poses, a purple-skinned woman with glowing yellow eyes, and a green cat with multiple eyes, all set against a black background with colorful paint drips and splatters in a vibrant psychedelic style.
